imagegen_mode: built-in image generation; palette/microdetail plus official-mask landmark decals

prompts.microtexture: Uniform seamless top-down microtexture only: tiny moss, soil grain and restrained cyan mineral flecks. No roads, rivers, pools, pits, walls, buildings, camps, lanes, landmarks, borders, symbols, lighting gradients or other terrain semantics.
prompts.wall_palette: Seamless orthographic top-down blue-gray slate cliff masonry with moss, roots, and restrained cyan mineral glints; original hand-painted MOBA environment texture.
prompts.bush_palette: Seamless orthographic top-down dense dark emerald brush with fine grass, ferns, blue-violet flowers, and controlled shadow pockets; original hand-painted MOBA texture.
prompts.landmark_common: One isolated square orthographic top-down hand-painted MOBA terrain decal, League-inspired but original, crisp readable stonework at small game scale, restrained cyan or team-color magic, no characters, monsters, buildings, text, logos, UI, roads, rivers, pools, walls, grass, perspective, or photographic lighting. Transparent outside the decal if possible; otherwise use one uniform #18382f background.

rejected_routes.reason: Whole-map generation added/shifted water and terrain semantics and caused visual-pathing mismatch; it is forbidden from runtime packing.

mask_audit.mask_derivation: official 32px-grid landmark rectangles plus conservative native contours; 2px native rim retained and feather is inward-only
